A '''XLT-014 labor droid''' was working on the cruise [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Galactic Breeze]]'' during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was reprogrammed to enter information into the ship's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] in order for the ship to go to the wrong location. When the ''Galactic Breeze'' reached the location, which was near the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]], a [[Unidentified pirate group (Galactic Breeze)|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] hijacked the ship.
